It is a valuable side-effect boundary with concrete controls, but transaction volume, trust effectiveness, and security outcomes are first-party or partner claims without a public implementation or independent audit.

history.note: Verified the official AWS Machine Learning Blog post dated 2026-09-01. The durable engineering angle is the control-plane trade-off between alignment, action monitoring, and monitorability, while independent replication, public traces, and production error rates remain unavailable.

history.note: Verified OpenAI's official safety overview dated 2026-09-03, the full GPT-6 Astra deployment safety hub, and the model announcement.
